name: Meta Platforms
outlook:
What Meta Platforms says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: total revenueWe expect fourth quarter 2026 total revenue to be in the range of $73-76 billion. Our guidance assumes foreign currency is an approximately 1% headwind to year-over-year total revenue growth, based on current exchange rates.
  • Full year 2026: total expensesWe now expect full year 2026 total expenses to be in the range of $175-179 billion.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresWe anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $135-145 billion, narrowed from our prior outlook of $130-145 billion.
  • Full year 2026: Reality Labs lossesAt a segment level, we now expect Reality Labs losses to decline compared to 2025 to a range of $18-19 billion.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: tax rateAbsent any changes to our tax landscape, we expect our fourth quarter 2026 tax rate to be between 15-17%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 21, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
